attributes.description: Current state and trends of vulnerability findings collected from ProjectDiscovery Cloud Platform.
Current findings, excluding fixed, false positive, duplicate and accepted risk.

query.esql:
FROM security_solution-projectdiscovery.vulnerability_latest
| WHERE ?severity IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?severity, vulnerability.severity)
| WHERE ?status IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?status, projectdiscovery.vulnerability.vuln_status)
| WHERE ?protocol IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?protocol, projectdiscovery.vulnerability.event.type)
| WHERE ?host IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?host, host.name)
| STATS findings = COUNT(*)

FROM security_solution-projectdiscovery.vulnerability_latest
| WHERE ?severity IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?severity, vulnerability.severity)

FROM logs-projectdiscovery.vulnerability-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE ?severity IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?severity, vulnerability.severity)
| WHERE ?status IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?status, projectdiscovery.vulnerability.vuln_status)
| WHERE ?protocol IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?protocol, projectdiscovery.vulnerability.event.type)
| WHERE ?host IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?host, host.name)
| WHERE projectdiscovery.vulnerability.vuln_status IS NULL OR projectdiscovery.vulnerability.vuln_status NOT IN ("fixed", "false_positive", "duplicate", "accepted_risk")
| STATS findings = COUNT_DISTINCT(event.id, 40000) BY timestamp = BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), vulnerability.severity

| WHERE ?protocol IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?protocol, projectdiscovery.vulnerability.event.type)

FROM security_solution-projectdiscovery.vulnerability_latest
| WHERE ?severity IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?severity, vulnerability.severity)
| WHERE ?status IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?status, projectdiscovery.vulnerability.vuln_status)
| WHERE ?protocol IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?protocol, projectdiscovery.vulnerability.event.type)
| WHERE ?host IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(?host, host.name)
| STATS findings = COUNT(*) BY host.name, vulnerability.severity
| INLINE STATS group_total = SUM(findings) BY host.name
| EVAL rank_key = CONCAT(TO_STRING(1000000000 + group_total), host.name)
| INLINE STATS rank_keys = TOP(rank_key, 50, "desc")
| WHERE MV_CONTAINS(MV_SLICE(MV_SORT(MV_DEDUPE(rank_keys), "DESC"), 0, 9), rank_key)
| SORT group_total DESC, host.name ASC
| KEEP host.name, vulnerability.severity, findings

| WHERE MV_CONTAINS(MV_SLICE(MV_SORT(MV_DEDUPE(rank_keys), "DESC"), 0, 9), rank_key)
| SORT group_total DESC, host.name ASC
